commonFailures.cause: @workspace/db selects TEST_DATABASE_URL for its pool and its legacy environment compatibility rewrites DATABASE_URL to the target. Descendants inherit that target alias, while direct suite checks also observe equal values.
commonFailures.fix: Runner supplies APPLICATION_DATABASE_URL as a stable runner-created control alias. Every actor preload restores DATABASE_URL synchronously from it and validates both signed URLs and both live identities before suite/worker imports. Suites capture the stable control alias before selecting their target pool.

commonFailures.cause: Runner-created target names used isolated_<random>, while the suite requires a visible test/ci/e2e marker.
commonFailures.fix: Every fresh target is now named isolated_test_<cryptographic-random>.

regressionCorrection.cause: The preload forced @workspace/db into every inherited worker. A logging worker therefore repeated assertPreparedTestDatabase after the business case had legally changed canonical-admin state.
regressionCorrection.fix: The preload retains raw target/control identity verification but no longer forces DB/readiness imports. Workers that actually import DB keep that module's own contracts.
